title: Suggestions: Insulin Treatment Protocols + Reminders
symptom: The user requests the ability to input more than one type of insulin for better blood sugar predictions, and also requests reminders for sensor life (e.g., Libre) on the last day, similar to the reader's reminder feature.
fix: The issue was closed as a duplicate, and a comment states that the capability to add multiple insulin types has already been added to xDrip.
evidence_quote: I think the capability to add multiple insulin types already has been added to xDrip. I am hence closing this issue.
